h1: Digital US Visa Photo Specs 2026 (DS-160 Image Requirements)
h1Subtitle: Official US Department of State Digital Image Guidelines
content:
When uploading a photo to the Consular Electronic Application Center (CEAC) for your DS-160 or DS-260 US visa application, the file must satisfy exact digital image specifications. Even a 1-pixel discrepancy or file-size error will cause the online portal to reject your upload. Use this comprehensive 2026 technical guide and free checker to ensure your US visa photo complies on the first attempt.

Official Technical Requirements at a Glance

Dimensions

600×600 to 1200×1200 px

Max File Size

240 KB

File Format

JPEG (.jpg)

Color Space

24-bit sRGB

Start with the Free DS-160 File Check

Check your DS-160 photo file for free in your browser. It verifies JPEG headers, square dimensions (600–1200px), and the 240 KB file size limit instantly without uploading your photo to any external server.

Detailed Digital Requirements Breakdown

  • Aspect Ratio: Exactly 1:1 (square). Width must equal height.
  • Minimum Resolution: 600 × 600 pixels at 300 DPI.
  • Maximum Resolution: 1200 × 1200 pixels at 300 DPI.
  • File Compression: Compression ratio must not exceed 20:1 to prevent compression artifacts.
  • Background: Plain white or off-white with no shadows or patterns.
  • Head Size Ratio: The head (from chin to top of hair) must occupy between 50% and 69% of the total image height.
  • Eye Height: Eye level must sit between 56% and 69% from the bottom of the image.

Troubleshooting Common DS-160 Upload Errors

  • 'Photo does not meet minimum dimensions': Ensure your photo is at least 600×600 pixels. Taking a screenshot of a photo often results in non-square dimensions.
  • 'File size exceeds 240 KB': High-resolution phone portraits often exceed 2–5 MB. Use our US Visa Photo Maker to compress and crop to exact DS-160 standards without losing biometric clarity.
  • 'Invalid image format': Even if renamed to .jpg, PNG or HEIC files will fail internal header inspection. Export directly as JPEG.
  • 'Glasses detected': Eyeglasses are prohibited in all US passport and visa photos since 2016.

faqs.q: What is the exact pixel size required for DS-160 photo upload?
faqs.a: The US Department of State requires a square JPEG image between 600 × 600 pixels and 1200 × 1200 pixels, with a maximum file size of 240 KB in sRGB color space.

faqs.q: Can I use a 2x2 inch printed photo for DS-160?
faqs.a: The online DS-160 portal requires a digital JPEG upload. For your in-person embassy or consulate interview, you may also need to bring two physical 2 × 2 inch (51 × 51 mm) printed photos.

faqs.q: Can I wear eyeglasses in a US visa photo?
faqs.a: No, eyeglasses are strictly banned in US visa and passport photos except for rare, documented medical emergencies.
